rules: PES-14 remains independently deployable with its existing schema and starter.
No implicit upgrade, downgrade, or rewriting of PES-14 canonical stores.
Migration creates a separate PES-15 snapshot with the source digest and preserved IDs, records and facts.
Historic missing priority and observation timestamps remain unknown, explicitly allowlisted as immutable legacy exceptions.
No guessed scope, freshness, acceptance, verification, provenance or priority.
A distinct PES-15 full-context retrieval contract is added without replacing the legacy default.
Schema changes for future versions require separate compatibility negotiation and migration tooling.
